name: Nakanobe Mari
source:
Likes: playing, her sister
Dislikes: homework, bitter things

Mari is Mayu's sister, and is quite fond of her. Though Mari and Mayu have opposite personalities, they're both stubborn.
She disappeared at Manten Aquarium 5 years ago.
She suddenly appeared in front of Mayu, but she looked the same as 5 years ago.

[Taken from [url=http://shizuku.aiueokompany.com/]Official Website[/url]]
